decision_rationale: Joint Placement and Receiving pairing both need keyed FinalScene render-data lookup/replacement, but pairing currently imports joint-policy private functions. Assembly marking geometry is pure vector/contact/backprojection and must not own scene replacements. Select a stateless, domain-neutral scene-access/replacement owner, with two production consumers and zero copied projection or tolerance oracle.

decision_evidence.pairing_private_import: ae_engine/receiving_pairing_marking.py imports the joint private owner functions
decision_evidence.scene_mutation_policy_owners: Remain in individual Joint Placement and Receiving pairing modules

scene_owner_responsibilities: immutable direct and composite owner render-data replacement
preserve existing scene and metadata identities

rejected_alternatives.ASSEMBLY_MARKING_GEOMETRY_SCENE_OWNER: Rejected: mixing FinalScene aggregate mutation with pure vector/contact/world-to-flat backprojection creates a broad second responsibility and risks policy leakage into the existing geometry oracle.
rejected_alternatives.KEEP_JOINT_PRIVATE_SEAM_FOR_PAIRING: Rejected: cross-feature private import makes Joint Placement a shared mutable-scene owner for Pairing and invites policy coupling.
rejected_alternatives.DUPLICATE_LOOKUP_IN_EACH_RESOLVER: Rejected: scene access/replacement and box_body preview refresh would regrow as two independent implementations.

acceptance: Commit design rationale and tested guard in production without implementing the new scene seam; C2 may cross boundary only after #1382 and #1383 terminal GREEN.
